name: Natural Earth (coastline, land, countries and populated places)

measures.definition: Straight-line distance from the centre to the open-sea coast.
Which tiles of the world map are land, and the country each one belongs to, from the 1:50m admin-0 countries.
Towns and cities of 100,000 people or more, plus every national capital, from the 1:10m populated places: what a click on the map can add.

rights.edition: Natural Earth 5.1 (1:50m admin-0, 1:10m populated places, coastline, land)

vetted.notes: Lakes and some tidal rivers excluded by hand for sea distance. The map leaves Antarctica out and keeps Somaliland, Northern Cyprus and the Siachen Glacier as land without a country code.

caveats: The map's tiles take the country most of their ground belongs to, so a small country (Singapore, Luxembourg) can share a tile with its neighbour; its cities still show as their own points.
